Description: Let API Developers provide an OpenAPI 3.0 specification and get it validated with clear feedback before any mock is generated.
Turn the paths, methods and schemas of a valid specification into live mock endpoints that return randomized, schema-compliant JSON.
Route client requests to the generated endpoints with correct status codes, configurable latency and performance under load.
As an API Developer, I want to upload an OpenAPI 3.0 specification in YAML or JSON format, so that the system can create a mock server from it.

Summary: Validate spec and report validation errors
Description: As an API Developer, I want the uploaded specification to be validated and any errors reported, so that mocks are never generated from an invalid spec.

Summary: Show success / actionable error message on upload
Description: As an API Developer, I want a clear success or actionable error message for every upload, so that I can quickly fix problems in my specification.

Summary: Extract paths & methods and generate mock endpoints
Description: As an API Developer, I want the system to extract every path and HTTP method and generate matching mock endpoints, so that I don't have to write stubs by hand.
As a QA Engineer, I want each mock endpoint to return randomized JSON that follows the response schema, so that I can test the client with realistic data.

Summary: Route requests; 404 unknown path, 405 bad method
Description: As an API Client / Testing Tool, I want requests routed to the matching mock endpoint, with 404 for unknown paths and 405 for unsupported methods, so that behaviour is predictable.
As an API Developer, I want to configure a simulated response latency per endpoint, so that I can test my client under slow network conditions.

Summary: Sustain 1,000 req/s with latency accurate to ±10 ms
Description: As a QA Engineer, I want the mock server to sustain 1,000 requests per second with latency accurate within ±10 ms, so that I can use it for load testing.
